sections.title: hand-written cases
sections.about: the 29 programs in cases/, each a shape that has tripped decompilers up

tests.name: calculator
tests.about: A tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for arithmetic, with variables and errors.

tests.name: captured_args
tests.about: a local that a closure assigns, read as an argument before a call that runs the closure

tests.name: closures
tests.about: upvalues, nested closures and recursion

tests.name: contextual_keywords
tests.about: `continue` is only a keyword where it can't be a variable: `while continue do` reads one

tests.name: control_flow
tests.about: branches and every loop kind

tests.name: dead_code
tests.about: a friend's case: a branch constant folding can prove dead (O1+ drops it entirely), with a numeric for over nils inside that would error if it ever ran

tests.name: debug_names
tests.about: compiled with debug level 2, so the real local names are in the bytecode

tests.name: deep_branches
tests.about: branch-heavy code (a friend's challenge): ifs nested 150 deep, 300 if/elseif/else in a row and 300 conditions with a dead `false and` part. A decompiler that retries a nested `if` on a failed attempt takes 2^depth steps here

tests.name: events
tests.about: event handlers and loops over instance collections

tests.name: if_local
tests.about: Luau's experimental `if local` / `while local` / `const` syntax (a friend's case). The binding lives only in the then-branch or loop body, so an outer variable with the same name has to stay visible in the else-branch, and every loop iteration gets a fresh local for closures.

tests.name: imports
tests.about: `a.b.c` on a global compiles to an import, looked up once when the script loads; with brackets it's read every time. The two have to stay apart

tests.name: inlining
tests.about: small local functions that -O2 copies into their callers

tests.name: inventory
tests.about: An inventory with stacking, weight limits and a sorted report.

tests.name: loop_closures
tests.about: closures made in loops: each iteration of a for loop has its own variable, a while loop's local is fresh each time round, and an upvalue written after capture is shared

tests.name: loop_exits
tests.about: loops whose exits carry a value out, and a loop body that needs a goto to structure

tests.name: loops
tests.about: breaks, continues and returns out of loops, each checked by running both versions

tests.name: multiple_assignment
tests.about: multiple assignment and multiple returns: every right-hand side is read before anything is assigned, a call in the middle of a list is cut to one value, and parentheses cut it too

tests.name: nan_comparisons
tests.about: comparisons a decompiler can't flip: with NaN, `not (a < b)` isn't `a >= b`, and `x ~= x` is true. Also and/or chains where a false or nil value in the middle changes which side wins

tests.name: nested_inlining
tests.about: shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

tests.name: numbers
tests.about: constants the compiler folds, and the places folding differs from running

tests.name: oop
tests.about: metatable classes with methods
